providerKind.description: WHICH vendor a `providerKey` opens — a cloud, an edge or a forge. Null for every other kind. outpostPublicKey.description: The public half of the Ed25519 pair THIS machine made at enrollment, base64url (`FJS-D1604`). The private half never leaves the machine, so the column is public by nature: nothing here can sign as it.  Null means the machine has not enrolled, and every signed request about it is refused (`outpostKeyFor` in `core/hooks.ts`). Nullable because the row exists before the machine does: provisioned or imported, it is created first and enrolls after.  `@system`: a caller who could write it would sign as `outpost:<id>` with a key of their own, without enrolling (`FJS-3904`). Enrollment is the writer.

outpostCert.description: The certificate this machine's command port answers with, PEM, handed over in the enrollment exchange and pinned on its Conduit target — the one certificate a command to it will accept (`FJS-1603`). Public by nature, so no protection. Null means no command can reach the machine: no target is registered without it, and the only way to change it is to enroll again.  `@system` for the reason `outpostPublicKey` is.
